issues.title: Deleting an agent conversation permanently removes all turns and events
issues.body:
# Description

Deleting an agent conversation immediately removes the conversation and all related turns and events from the database.

The deletion cannot be recovered, and no independent audit record is created to identify who deleted the conversation or when.
